help.en: Something the organisation wants to achieve, with a time horizon and a way to measure it.
How many objectives, value drivers, initiatives, use cases and benefits point to this goal.

constraints.message: = 'Nothing supports the goal "' + Name + '" yet: no objective, value driver, initiative, use case or benefit points to it.'

help.en: A way to use AI for a business purpose, rated by the value it brings and how feasible it is.

attributes.formula: Value == null || Feasibility == null ? null : Value * Feasibility

help.en: Value times feasibility, from 1 to 25.
A project or programme with a sponsor, a budget and dates.
The quarter in which it delivers, such as "2027 Q3".
The roadmap phase it sits in.
The risk-adjusted value of the benefits it realises.

attributes.formula: Budget == null || Budget == 0 ? null : round(ExpectedBenefit / Budget, 2)

help.en: Expected benefit divided by budget. Above 1 the initiative pays for itself.

constraints.message: = 'Initiative "' + Name + '" is not linked to the strategy: connect it to a goal or objective with "Contributes to", or to the AI use case it implements.'

constraints.formula: Start == null || End == null || Start <= End

help.en: A measurable gain that a change is expected to bring, and what it has brought so far.
The value per year once the change is in place, in your currency.
The value reached so far, per year.
How sure the estimate is. Low counts 30%, Medium 60% and High 90% of it.
The estimated value weighted by the confidence.

attributes.formula: EstimatedValue == null || RealisedValue == null || EstimatedValue == 0 ? null : round(RealisedValue / EstimatedValue * 100, 1)

help.en: The realised value as a percentage of the estimate.
Where the organisation wants to be with data and AI, in one or two sentences.
The year the vision aims at, such as 2030.
A measurable step towards a goal, with a target date and an owner.
How progress is measured.
A way data and AI create value, such as revenue growth or lower cost. Benefits count towards it.
Something the organisation must be able to do with data or AI, with its maturity now and the maturity it needs.
1 initial, 2 repeatable, 3 defined, 4 managed, 5 optimised.
The maturity the strategy needs.

attributes.formula: CurrentMaturity == null || TargetMaturity == null ? null : TargetMaturity - CurrentMaturity

help.en: Target maturity minus current maturity.
A stretch of time on the roadmap, such as a year. Place the initiatives of that phase inside it.
Such as "2027" or "2027 Q1 to Q2".
Something helps to reach a goal or to move a KPI.
An objective makes a goal concrete, or a goal works towards the vision.
The value driver is a reason for the goal or objective.
The initiative or use case brings the benefit.
The initiative builds and runs the AI use case.
The initiative raises the maturity of the capability.
The use case cannot work without the capability.
The initiative can start or finish only after the other initiative, or once the capability is in place.
The budget of all initiatives.
The risk-adjusted value of all benefits, per year.
A vision with goals and objectives, value drivers, AI use cases, data and AI capabilities, initiatives on a roadmap and their benefits.

parts.fill: = Status == 'Proposed' ? '#fff4e6' : Status == 'Approved' ? '#ffe8cc' : Status == 'In progress' ? '#ffd8a8' : Status == 'Done' ? '#d3f9d8' : Status == 'Stopped' ? '#e9ecef' : '#fff4e6'
